en:
Tripe hot pot is my favorite out of all the
hot pot dishes!

Tripe is the best! I can feel it turning into
energy the moment I eat it!
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Tenko for a while?

By the way, what's your favorite hot pot dish,
Shuichi? It better not be the same as me!

I can't bear the thought of liking the same
thing as a degenerate!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko and I spent some time
discussing the perfect hot pot.
<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko and I grew a little closer today.
